title: Associate in Biomedical Informatics
bio: Research Michail Andreopoulos graduated from the University of Cambridge in 2023 with an MPhil in Computational Biology and from the University of Manchester in 2022 with a BSc in Physics. During his undergraduate studies, he developed a deep interest in biophysics and conducted research on computational models designed to explain the biomechanics of the heart and the underlying causes of cardiac arrhythmia. As a part of his MPhil degree, he developed a computational methodology that utilized supervised machine learning to identify data-driven patient selection criteria in breast cancer clinical trials. He is currently an Associate Computational Biologist in the Park Lab, working on applying statistical algorithms to understand cancer evolution, through the analysis of mutational signatures.
